item.title: Middle East war live: Rubio says Iran deal still possible Monday
item.description: US Secretary of State Marco Rubio said Monday that a deal to end the war with Iran could materialise "today", adding that Israel had the right to defend itself against attack. Follow our liveblog for all the latest updates.

item.title: 'Cold, pragmatic relationship': UAE-Israel ties driven by defence and technology
item.description: Nadia Massih is pleased to welcome Dr Andreas Krieg, Senior Lecturer at the School of Security Studies at King's College London and Fellow at the Institute of Middle Eastern Studies. According to Krieg, "Iran is fighting a war against the global economy." By targeting the UAE, and especially Dubai, Tehran is not merely retaliating militarily but seeking to exploit what Krieg calls the "Achilles heel" of the international system: the Gulf's hyperconnected financial and logistical infrastructure.

item.title: 'Time is on our side': Trump tempers expectations of a peace deal with Iran
item.description: US President Donald Trump on Sunday said that he had told diplomatic representatives not to "rush into a deal" with Tehran to end the US-Israeli war on Iran, walking back earlier signals of progress towards a peace agreement. The draft agreement would reportedly postpone talks over Iran's nuclear programme, instead starting with reopening the crucial Strait of Hormuz.

item.title: War in the Middle East: Trump says Iran deal 'largely negociated'
'Significant movement here in Washington': US-Iran progress towards deal
item.description: FRANCE 24 correspondent Fraser Jackson speaks from Washington, DC on the reported progress in the talks on ending the US-Israeli war on Iran.

item.title: Iran, US and Pakistan report progress in talks on ending war
item.description: Washington, Tehran and mediator Islamabad all said on Saturday that progress had been made on ending the US-Israeli war on Iran, with a Pakistani security official saying that a memorandum of understanding was being "fine-tuned".

item.title: War in the Middle East: US-Iran talks make headway
item.description: Anahita Motazed Rad, Associate Fellow at the London School of Economics, is our guest.

item.title: US and Iran are ‘getting a lot closer’ to finalising agreement, Trump says
item.description: US President Donald Trump on Saturday told US broadcaster CBS that Tehran and Washington were "getting a lot closer" to finalising an agreement between the two countries. Iran earlier said that it was in the “final stage” of drafting an agreement with the US to end the US-Israeli war on Iran, the Islamic Republic’s state media reported. Read our liveblog to see how the day's events unfolded.

item.title: Trump says Iran deal 'largely negotiated', would reopen Strait of Hormuz
item.description: A "largely negotiated" memorandum of understanding on an Iran peace ​deal would reopen the Strait of Hormuz, U.S. President Donald Trump said on Saturday, as expectations rose that a turning point might be imminent in the three-month-old war.

item.title: France bans Israeli minister Itamar Ben-Gvir after 'unspeakable' behavior
item.description: France on Saturday banned Israel’s far-right national security minister, Itamar Ben-Gvir, citing his "unspeakable" behavior targeting activists from a flotilla to Gaza who were detained by his police force.
